items.titleIt: Three Egyptian nationals jailed for 10 years over Italian researcher's abduction

items.title: Regeni family lawyer says govt must acknowledge ruling and sever ties with Egypt
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, 28 SET - Giulio Regeni's family lawyer said Monday that the Italian government must acknowledge a Rome court ruling finding three Egyptian security officials guilty of the student's abduction in Cairo in January 2016 and must therefore sever ties with Egypt. "Now our government, too, must acknowledge this, demand compensation for damages as requested by the State Attorney's Office, and sever ties with a country that—far from being safe—tortures and kills even citizens of so-called friendly states," said Alessandra Ballerini, after the three got 10 years each in jail in absenbtia
items.titleIt: Regeni family lawyer says govt must acknowledge ruling and sever ties with Egypt

items.title: Ethiopia: Tensions Return to Tigray - Fears of a New Civil War
items.description: [Agenzia Fides] Mekelle -- Fears of a new escalation in Ethiopia are growing following the resumption of fighting in the north of the country and an offensive by Tigrayan fighters in the neighboring regions of Afar and Amhara. Concern is also mounting over the formation of a new alliance of armed groups that has declared its intention to overthrow the government of Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed.

items.title: Vintage Alfa Romeos on display at the 54th edition of the Africa Concours d’Elegance
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 29 SET - The 54th edition of the Africa Concours d’Elegance took place in Nairobi. Organized by the Alfa Romeo Owners Club (Kenya) since 1971, the event is the most prestigious and eagerly anticipated gathering on the continental African motorsports calendar dedicated to classic cars and motorcycles. The Ngong Racetrack hosted the classic Alfa Romeos with which the Italian Embassy, together with the Italian Cultural Institute in Nairobi and the ICE Agency, celebrated the design, engineering, and creativity that define Italian excellence. Read article...
